rows.title: Tolerance, physical dependence, and Δ(9)-THC-like interoceptive effects of cannabinol in mice.
rows.evidence_boundary: Tolerance and dependence findings are from short repeated-dose mouse experiments; human dependence liability, exposure thresholds, and clinical relevance remain uncertain.

rows.title: Residue Interaction Network Reveals Allosteric Pathways Linking Orthosteric and Intracellular Sites in Class A GPCRs.
rows.evidence_boundary: The work is molecular-dynamics modeling of GPCR allostery, including cannabinoid receptors; it is mechanistic and does not establish compound efficacy or clinical effects.

rows.title: Interactions of ACEA and WIN 55,212-2 mesylate with temozolomide and cisplatin in neuroblastoma and glioblastoma cell lines: an isobolographic analysis.
rows.evidence_boundary: Results are from tumor cell-line assays using cannabinoid receptor agonists with chemotherapy; they are not evidence for clinical cannabinoid treatment or supplement use.

rows.title: Predicting Cannabidiol Pharmacokinetics in Older Adults Via Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Modeling.
rows.evidence_boundary: PBPK predictions integrate in vitro and modeled physiology; they are useful for hypothesis generation but require prospective human validation, especially in older adults with comorbidities.

rows.title: Why Serum Magnesium Fails: A Narrative Review of Magnesium Biochemistry, Compartmental Exchange, and Endpoint Selection for Supplementation Trials.
rows.evidence_boundary: This narrative review focuses on magnesium biomarkers and trial endpoint selection; it informs interpretation of supplementation studies but does not establish efficacy for any clinical outcome.
